Name: Zc_Hub_Porter
$Comment: The temple hub's porter's conversation, which its placement (NpcPlacements/Zc_Hub_Porter.json) opens on press F: the hub's two ways out. Back to the temple opens the Instance destination on the game's own shared temple copy, Forgotten_Temple_Goblins, so a player who came from the temple stands beside the doorkeeper again; out to the overworld opens the Overworld destination, which leaves every instance for where the player stood before they went in.
